entries.title: Capell admin dashboard with the Welcome Tour onboarding checklist.
entries.notes: Capture from a disposable installed Capell application with Welcome Tour enabled and onboarding checklist state available for the authenticated administrator.
entries.useCase: A first-time administrator lands on the dashboard checklist and can launch onboarding.

entries.title: Welcome tour overlay showing the first configured onboarding step.
entries.notes: Use an admin account that has not dismissed the tour.
entries.useCase: A first-time administrator sees the first configured tour step overlay.

entries.title: Welcome tour settings action with enabled toggle and step repeater.
entries.notes: Open the Welcome Tour settings action from the Extensions manager after publishing and running the package settings migration.
entries.useCase: A site owner configures the enabled state and tour step repeater from the extension management surface.

entries.title: User edit form with Show welcome tour toggle.
entries.notes: Requires a users table with the dismissed_hints column so the bridge contributes the field.
entries.useCase: An administrator toggles whether a user should see the welcome tour again from the user edit form.

entries.title: Capell admin dashboard with the Welcome Tour onboarding checklist with admin sidebar menu open.
entries.notes: Capture from a disposable installed Capell application with Welcome Tour enabled and onboarding checklist state available for the authenticated administrator. Capture this same admin surface with the fully collapsible sidebar opened.
entries.useCase: A first-time administrator lands on the dashboard checklist and can launch onboarding.
